notes.title: Hook 2.0.1
notes.content:
Hello! 

Hook just received a big update. 

I had to rewrite the whole game ;) But now I'm able to create new levels and make more frequent updates. 

[b]What's new: [/b]
- Rewrote the whole game, recreated all the classic levels
- Added 10 new levels (more coming soon)
- Added Cloud Saves
- Added Dark Mode
- Added New Menu
- Animations are better
- Game runs smoother
- Linux version should work better

Please let me know if you encountered any bugs. People who deleted the game, but had finished it before, should be able to start from level 50.  Thanks! 

[b]HOOK 2 NEWS:[/b]
HOOK 2 Is coming next month. I just uploaded a new trailer. The demo will be available in 2 weeks. 
I would really appreciate if you could add it to wishlist or share the news. It would help me a ton!
Cheers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1871310/Hook_2/

notes.title: Hook: A Quietly Satisfying Mini Puzzler
notes.content:
Sometimes you need a puzzle game that’s Stephen’s Sausage Roll levels of difficulty – i.e. every completed grill is a hard fought mental victory you feel deserves some kind of acknowledgement in the local paper and maybe a parade. But sometimes you want a puzzle that gently nudges at your brain and only occasionally demands you step back and develop and actual strategy. Hook [official site] is the latter for me right now.

… [visit site to read more]
